issue.title: add_or_update_prompt drops a failed prompt-history save silently (no log at error level, no toast)

task_type_fields.impact: A prompt the user submitted or cancelled can silently fail to reach prompt history, the last-resort recovery surface for prompts that were never stashed. The user finds out only when the prompt is missing later.
task_type_fields.repro:
`src/sase/history/prompt_store_mutations.py::add_or_update_prompt` calls `_apply_prompt_mutations(mutations, current_timestamp)` and discards its `bool` result. `_apply_prompt_mutations` returns `False` when `store.save_shard(...)` fails: `save_shard` in `src/sase/history/prompt_store.py` catches the write error and returns `False`. No caller logs or toasts that failure. Callers include `_prompt_bar_mount.py:171` (cancelled drafts), `launch_cwd_single.py:137`, and `launch_cwd_fanout.py:86/251`.

Repro (code-level): make the prompt-history shard dir unwritable (for example `chmod -w ~/.sase/prompt_history/<shard dir>` in a sandboxed SASE_HOME), then launch or cancel a prompt from ACE. `add_or_update_prompt` returns normally and nothing is recorded, logged at error level, or shown to the user.

Fix direction (listed in the approved sase-1ca plan's follow-up candidates as "error toasts when a prompt-history save returns False"): return the save result, or raise, from `add_or_update_prompt`, then have TUI callers toast an error and log it through the `sase` logger.

issue.creation_reason: The approved sase-1ca plan listed missing error toasts for failed prompt-history saves as an out-of-scope follow-up; the sase-1ca land agent confirmed the ignored return value while routing follow-ups.

payload.description: Same add_or_update_prompt write path in sase.history; a fix touching the prompt_store/mutations split may collide
